# Book of Giants Fragment 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4Q530 col. iii (Cave 4) | **Condition:** partially preserved; several complete lines survive

---

**4:1** Then Hahya told his-dream, and-he-said: What I-saw in-my-dream is-also terrifying.

**4:2** [...] behold, I-saw rulers [...] angels-of-punishment [...]

**4:3** [...] coming-down from-heaven [...] with-weapons-of wrath [...]

**4:4** [...] and-they-came upon the-Watchers [...] and upon-their-sons [...]

**4:5** [...] saying to-them: You-have-corrupted the-earth [...]

**4:6** [...] I-saw rulers [...] angels-of-punishment coming-down from-heaven [...]

**4:7** [...] and-their-faces were-like lightning [...]

**4:8** [...] and-their-appearance was-like burning fire [...]

**4:9** [...] saying to-them: Give-account [...]

**4:10** [...] for-that-which has-been-done on-earth [...] by-your-hands [...]

**4:11** [...] that-which has-been-done on-earth [...] they-know all the-mysteries [...]

**4:12** [...] and-none-of the-secrets is-hidden from-them [...]

**4:13** [...] the-secrets-of heaven [...] you-have-revealed on-earth [...]

**4:14** [...] and-the-forbidden-knowledge you-have-taught to-mankind [...]

**4:15** [...] violence and-killing [...] until the-great-judgment [...]

**4:16** [...] blood-guilt lies-upon-you [...] and-upon all your-offspring [...]

**4:17** [...] and-there-is-no ransom [...] for-your-transgression [...]

**4:18** [...] the-sword and-destruction [...] shall-come upon-you [...]

**4:19** [...] and-upon your-wives [...] and-upon your-children [...]

**4:20** [...] for all the-unrighteousness that-you-have-wrought [...]

---

*EMET notes: Fragment 4 (Hahya's Dream). Source: 4Q530 col. iii. Aramaic text from Cave 4 Qumran. Hyphenated compounds preserve Aramaic construct-chain syntax and bound morphemes. Square brackets indicate genuine manuscript lacunae where the leather has deteriorated or broken away. The Book of Giants is an Aramaic expansion of the Watcher myth from 1 Enoch 6-16, featuring the Nephilim giants Ohya, Hahya (sons of Shemihazah), Mahaway (son of Baraq'el), and the hero Gilgamesh.*
